shot_blocks.emotional_or_attention_beat: Recognize the hexagonal graphite shell first, then read the two powder colors after the lid opens.

entity_actions.initial_state: The unbranded six-sided dry-pressed powder compact is closed, centered, and dry.
entity_actions.trigger: A soft studio reflection reveals the graphite shell as the lid begins to rotate on its rear hinge.
entity_actions.path: open the lid from closed to 105 degrees during the first second, then hold for 0.8 seconds with both powder colors visible
entity_actions.physical_consequence: The rigid lid moves only around its hinge; the powder core remains intact and seated in the tray.
entity_actions.final_state: The lid is open at 105 degrees; the hexagonal casing and ivory/pale-apricot powder surface are readable.

environment_action.initial_state: Neutral dark virtual studio; matte ground and background remain continuous.
environment_action.response: The shell reflection follows its curved edge; the backdrop remains still.
environment_action.final_state: The virtual studio remains quiet and the product stays spatially anchored.

camera.motivation: recognize the object, then reveal the material it contains

shot_blocks.look_delta: a broad reflection follows the opening graphite lid and reveals the two powder colors
shot_blocks.transition_out: Match the diagonal powder-color boundary to the same boundary in the contact macro; keep the lid open.

shot_blocks.emotional_or_attention_beat: The tool contact is readable as a deliberate material visualization, while the powder core stays complete.

entity_actions.initial_state: The compact lid remains open at 105 degrees; the short velvet contact face hovers just above the intact powder surface.
entity_actions.trigger: The applicator lowers until its short-fiber face makes light contact with the powder.
entity_actions.path: press gently without gouging, travel a few millimeters along the color boundary, then lift to show a small clear gap
entity_actions.physical_consequence: The velvet nap compresses, a thin layer of powder adheres to it, and a few fine dry grains leave the contact edge as the nap separates.
entity_actions.final_state: The applicator has lifted clear of the surface; only a shallow contact trace remains and the pressed core is intact.

environment_action.initial_state: Neutral dark virtual studio; matte ground and background remain continuous.
environment_action.response: A small local contact shadow closes and reopens as the applicator touches and lifts.
environment_action.final_state: The virtual studio remains quiet and the product stays spatially anchored.

camera.end_target: the gap between lifted velvet and powder
camera.focus: focus remains on the contact edge and fine departing grains
camera.motivation: make contact, adhesion and separation readable

shot_blocks.composition_state: tool edge and powder surface in one readable plane
shot_blocks.look_delta: local contact shadow; no smoke, liquid, or deep excavation
shot_blocks.transition_in: Continue the powder-color boundary and diagonal orientation established at the end of the opening reveal.
shot_blocks.transition_out: Follow the few lifted grains from this exact contact patch into the wider material event in the particle return.
continuity_locks: only the applicator short-fiber face contacts the powder surface

shot_blocks.emotional_or_attention_beat: Fine powder briefly opens and falls back as a controlled visual metaphor, without claiming process or performance.

entity_actions.initial_state: The lid stays open and the applicator leaves the frame; fine grains depart the contact patch without breaking the core.
entity_actions.trigger: The departing grains become an explicitly art-directed CG material visualization.
entity_actions.path: expand a thin veil from the contact patch for 0.6 seconds, curve it downward for 0.8 seconds, then let it settle toward visible front-tray contact points for one second
entity_actions.physical_consequence: Individual dry grains remain fine and separated; the tray is the visible destination below the hinge, and the pressed core remains intact. This artistic excursion is not a performance or manufacturing demonstration.
entity_actions.final_state: The lid is still open, the powder core is complete, and nearly all loose grains have settled onto the tray.

environment_action.initial_state: Neutral dark virtual studio; matte ground and background remain continuous.
environment_action.response: Background remains still; only the declared fine-powder layer changes and then recedes.
environment_action.final_state: The virtual studio remains quiet and the product stays spatially anchored.

continuity_locks: powder layer remains sparse and symbolic

shot_blocks.emotional_or_attention_beat: The final hero returns to the complete object and its two-tone material hierarchy.

entity_actions.initial_state: The same compact remains open at 105 degrees with its intact powder core and the last fine grains settling in the tray.

entity_actions.physical_consequence: The rigid casing and open lid stay fixed; settled grains remain in the tray rather than disappearing or entering the hinge.
entity_actions.final_state: The open graphite hexagonal shell, hinge and two-color powder core remain simultaneously readable with no text.
